_meta.source: Libro de los juysios de calatarama, universal chapter tables, as translated in Appendix 1 of A.J.C. Finan, 'The Book of the Judgements of Calatarama' (Univ. of Toronto, 2023)
_meta.why: a figure x house ruling grid from the 13th-15th c. Arabic-derived tradition; typed translation, no OCR loss
_meta.usage: quote with the folio; it is a translation of one manuscript, not a universal rule
_meta.missing_houses: VIII and X have no such table in this manuscript (the thesis marks them N/A)
